summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor skeleton plus a new React dashboard UI (auth/login, profile, wallet, contributions, governance) and supporting hooks/styles. However, several core backend requirements (stable persistence, full ICRC-1 interface, initial mint/owner placeholder flow, bulk airdrop, deterministic reward config, and DAO timing/execution rules) are not evidenced in the truncated backend diff, and the frontend does not show a complete governance voting flow. Some extra features (user profile name storage, secret-token-based access-control initialization) appear that were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Citizen Registry assigns unique sequential IDs and persists the counter and mapping in stable memory across upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows `var lastCitizenId = 0;` and `principalToCitizenId = Map.empty<Principal, Nat>()`, but no evidence of `stable var`, `preupgrade/postupgrade`, or other stable-memory persistence for the counter/mapping across upgrades in the visible diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement SUZHI token following the ICRC-1 standard interface (name/symbol/decimals/total_supply/fee/balance_of/transfer/metadata) with max supply 1,000,000,000 and configurable fee + clear insufficient funds errors.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows `totalSuzi = 1_000_000_000` and `allBalances = Map.empty<Principal, Nat>()`, and the frontend calls `actor.getBalance` and `actor.transfer`, but there is no evidence of the ICRC-1 standard endpoints (`icrc1_*` methods, metadata, fee, decimals, etc.) in the visible backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Mint entire supply at initialization to owner Principal ID placeholder "[INSERT_YOUR_PRINCIPAL_ID_HERE]" and provide controller-restricted one-time method to set/replace placeholder before production.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows `owner : ?Principal = null;` and a `checkValidPrincipalId` that hard-codes a specific principal and traps with a message referencing the placeholder, but there is no evidence of: (a) initial minting of the full supply to the configured owner at init, or (b) a controller-restricted one-time method to set the real owner when placeholder is present.

missing_requirements.requirement: Owner-restricted bulk distribution method `bulkAirdrop(recipients: [Principal], amount: Nat)` with clear error reporting and no silent partial application.
missing_requirements.reason: No `bulkAirdrop` method is visible in the backend diff summary (backend/main.mo is truncated, and no evidence of this method appears in shown sections).

missing_requirements.requirement: Proof of Contribution: create logs in four categories and require exactly 2 unique peer verifications (not the worker) before backend automatically transfers SUZHI; persist logs and verification state in stable memory; UI shows counts/status.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend implements work-log creation UI with the 4 categories and displays `validations` and status, but backend evidence is incomplete: only in-memory maps are shown (`workLogs`, `workLogVerifications`) with no stable persistence shown, and no visible backend logic proving: (a) unique verifier enforcement, (b) exactly-2 verification trigger, (c) automatic token transfer on second verification, (d) rewarded cannot happen twice.

missing_requirements.requirement: Deterministic reward calculation with configurable parameters set by admin/owner; record reward paid per log.
missing_requirements.reason: No reward configuration types/methods, admin-only update method, or recorded reward amount for each work log are evidenced in the visible backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: DAO: proposal submission (description, budget, timeline), 7-day discussion + 5-day voting enforced by backend, token-weighted voting, outcome computed after voting, and automatic execution for proposals approved by >50% with on-chain effect; frontend supports list/detail/submit/vote with phase indicators.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend shows proposal list + creation form and a phase indicator computed client-side from `startTime`. Backend DAOProposal type shown lacks a `timeline` field and no backend timing enforcement, voting methods, token-weighted vote accounting, end-of-vote outcome computation, or automatic execution effect are evidenced in the visible backend snippet. Frontend diff also does not show a voting UI/action (only list and create are shown).

hallucinated_features.description: User profile system requiring users to enter and save a name via a modal (ProfileSetupModal) and backend `UserProfile` storage.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for collecting/storing a user name; it only requires showing principal + citizen ID in the profile section.

hallucinated_features.description: Secret-token-based access control initialization from URL parameter `caffeineAdminToken` calling backend method `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify an admin secret token bootstrap flow via URL parameters or an `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` method; it only specifies owner/controller-restricted admin operations.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai attribution link and UTM parameters in the app footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; it is additional user-facing UI content.
